newsitem.title: ANTIGUA: CRICKET-INDIA OPENERS UNTROUBLED AS TEST HEADS FOR DRAW.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA OPENERS UNTROUBLED AS TEST HEADS FOR DRAW.

text.p: India's openers Venkata Laxman and Ajay Jadeja shared an unbroken stand of 97 as the rain-hit fourth test against the West Indies headed for a predictable draw on Tuesday.
Laxman was 56 not out and Jadeja unbeaten on 35 at tea in reply to the hosts first innings total of 333 for nine declared.
Both batted confidently despite some aggressive bowling from pacers Curtley Ambrose and Ian Bishop.
Laxman, who only kept his place in the side because of Navjot Sidhu's illness, struck five fours as he reached his second half-century of the series in 111 minutes.
